description: The MCP servers a project's repository declares in its MCP file (.mcp.json by default), each with its binding: enabled roles, transport, status, approved tools, per-role effective tool counts (null when the server runs inside the sandbox and the role gets every tool it exposes), and the NAMES of the credential fields set (never values). Also reports whether the file could be read (configStatus).
name: list_mcp_servers
title: List a project's MCP servers
